alt_text: Slide 1 of 6. Work and money belong in an honest rebuilding story.
Slide 2 of 6. My experience has included trying to keep responsibilities moving while work and business plans did not unfold as hoped.
Slide 3 of 6. I do not want to replace that reality with a success story that has not happened.
Slide 4 of 6. This page will talk about practical decisions, uncertainty, and starting again without turning a setback into a character flaw.
Slide 5 of 6. It will not offer investment tips, guaranteed income, or a shortcut out of financial pressure.
Slide 6 of 6. Follow for the part of rebuilding that happens between the inspirational moments.
